# NorthBridge

> NorthBridge is an AI business automation company for small businesses. It builds and maintains automation workflows, led by an automated payment-chasing system, plus AI client communication and AI fluency training, in English and Spanish, for clients in the United States and Latin America.

## What NorthBridge does

- Payment chasing automation: checks who has paid, automatically reminds late clients, notifies the team. Flagship product. $99/month pilot, no setup fee, 30-day money-back guarantee.
- Cinderella (data & workflows): cleans data, automates back-office workflows in the client's own n8n account.
- Hermes (client communication): follow-up sequences, instant AI messaging, AI voice agents, and websites built and kept up to date.
- Socrates (AI training): team workshops and custom curricula so businesses actually adopt AI tools.
- PerceptFolio (perceptfolio.com): the NorthBridge trading terminal. Every position requires a written thesis, a stop and a deadline. Calibration mode hides the ticker on three years of real daily closes so the operator can test whether they can actually read price action. A single command screen surfaces sell signals, breached limits, stops hit, reviews due and idle cash. Every call is scored against the S&P 500 at 30, 90, 180 and 365 days with confidence intervals, judged on expectancy rather than win rate, and roughly 138 scored calls are needed before a record counts as evidence. It applies rules its operator configures to public data and shows the arithmetic. It is not a broker, executes no trades, holds no client funds, makes no recommendation, and publishes no performance figures.
- Real estate: a fifth practice in preparation, not yet launched.

## How it works

The NorthBridge Cycle: Diagnose (2–3 days) → Build (3–7 days) → Educate & Train (1 session), repeating quarterly. Clients own their n8n accounts and their workflows. Maximum 5 new clients onboarded per month.

## Pricing

- Pilot: $99/month, 90 days, money-back guarantee in the first 30 days
- Starter bundle: $299/month
- Growth bundle: $649/month (includes one month of the PerceptFolio terminal free)
- Scale bundle: $699/month (includes one month of the PerceptFolio terminal free)
